name: LOVATO RGK400SA generator controller
summary: Compact stand-alone generator controller with an icon display and front programming interface.
description: Use the RGK400SA model for the smaller operator-panel opening. Arrange the faceplate for clear indication and locate rear wiring so the controller can be removed without disturbing adjacent equipment.
Use the linked manufacturer CAD for dimensions and the exact selected configuration. The downloadable illustration here is original educational geometry, unitless and not to scale.
readingNotes: The manufacturer lists 12/24 V DC supply and optional expansion capability. Include fitted expansion parts in the rear envelope.
RGK400SA and RGK600SA have different front sizes; their cutouts are not interchangeable.
drawingChecklist: Check connector access, wiring slack and visibility.
distinction: RGK400SA and RGK600SA have different front sizes; their cutouts are not interchangeable.
